_comment: v1.16.1 - De Coniuratione Catilinae 10-14: the dark half of the archaeology (10-13) and Catiline's following (14), each a whole chapter. sall.1 prints bare section digits, so every passage starts ON its digit. Two boundaries differ from Perseus (10.4 at Namque, not at pro his; 13.5 at animus, not at ad facinora) and two wordings are variants (10.3 primo imperi, deinde pecuniae against the manuscripts' pecuniae ... imperi; 14.5 molles etiam against aetate): the page is followed and both variants are explained in the notes.
cat.11: 1 Sed primo magis ambitio quam avaritia
